text:
anya: FYI deploy-bot flagged embeddings route after today's rollout to release/v2.5.1 — canary p95 jumped ~2x. Holding the deploy.
deploy-bot: AUTOPAUSE: Canary suspended by safety-latch. Metric: embeddings.p95_latency > 2x baseline. Suggested action: investigate or pin.
sam: @anya should we let deploy-bot do an auto-rollback or prefer manual intervention? We have a few enterprise customers on dedicated pools.
lee: If dedicated customers are using the variant, we should avoid a full auto-rollback. Consider routing pin for hosted public endpoints first.
anya: Agreed. Manual pin for hosted embeddings to tag v2.5.0 (previous stable). Keep canary at 1% for telemetry. Hold auto-rollback to avoid touching dedicated.
ops-runner: Running pin now:
```
routerctl pin --route embeddings --target-tag v2.5.0 --canary 1 --reason "p95 spike after v2.5.1" 
```
ops-runner: Pin applied. Hosted embeddings traffic: 99% -> v2.5.0, 1% canary on v2.5.1. Auto-rollback suppressed by operator.
sam: Nice. Can someone run a quick warmup on v2.5.0 nodes and then smoke the critical flows? We need login, embeddings-create, and batch-embedding flow.
ops-runner: Warmup + smoke kicked off. ETA ~2 mins.
sre-jen: Observed correlation with KV eviction count rising immediately post-merge. Might be model KV format mismatch. If so, pin will help but we need a patch. Opening an investigation ticket.
ops-runner: Smoke: login ok, embeddings-create throughput OK on pinned tag, but sample quality check shows minor vector drift on one test prompt (not customer-visible yet). Latency improved to baseline.
lee: Good. That means pin buys us time. Recommend we keep suppression for 45min, run regression test suite, and prepare a controlled rollback plan for embeddings-only if we find functional regressions.
kate: Drafting customer advisory: "Temporary routing pin to previous version for embeddings due to increased latency; no errors observed; monitoring closely." Any additions?
anya: Add ETA for next update: 30m and note potential targeted rollback if regression found.
sam: I'll queue the public post. Also let's decide rollback criteria: if embeddings.p95 > 500ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, trigger rollback. Sound good?
sre-jen: Agree. Add KV-compat tests to the post-merge CI and link to INF-1801.
ops-runner: Follow-up after 20m: metrics stable on pinned traffic, p95 ~210ms. Sample quality check passes on 99/100 prompts.
anya: OK keep pin. Schedule a hotfix branch to address KV format change and add regression tests. Who will pick INF-1801?
sre-jen: I'll own INF-1801 and coordinate with ml-oncall. Adding CI gating for KV shapes.
lee: Once INF-1801 PR is ready, we can try an A/B reroll to v2.5.1 with KV-compat patch on 10% to verify. Keep deploy-bot autorevert enabled for that experiment but ensure dedicated pools excluded.
anya: Good plan. Sam/kate, await customer note send after 15m stable. ops-runner, keep suppression until we flip the A/B reroll.
ops-runner: Suppression noted. Standing by for PR + canary reattempt.
kate: Customer advisory queued for send in 12m if no regression. (:eyes:)
sam: I'll prepare a short post-mortem blurb for release notes.
anya: Closing: manual pin applied, auto-rollback suppressed for hosted embeddings, smoke verified, INF-1801 created, next step hotfix + 10% A/B test. Reopen thread if metrics change. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
